note: EVIDENCE: Deezer album and track lists (labels, years, timings; album ids in sources) and Apple Music searches (composerTerm and song searches; the search URLs are in sources) are the recording evidence; MusicBrainz work-to-recording counts stand in where no performer could be named (those entries are confidence low); the en and fr Wikipedia work lists give the work lists (Françaix's is the Schott catalogue). No publisher page was opened, so floor.published is mostly empty and every entry rests on a recording; the scorings of Boulez's Mémoriale (Universal Edition), Jolivet's Rhapsodie à sept and Murail's Treize couleurs du soleil couchant (IRCAM) come from web-search summaries of those catalogue pages. IMSLP: the three candidates are kept (Jolivet's Petite Suite, composed 1941 and published 1983; Tailleferre's String Quartet and Image). BENCHMARK: Messiaen's Quatuor pour la fin du temps reported unchanged, no issue. VIOLIN CATALOGUE: none cross-listed: id 419 (Amy, 6 Duos for two violins) is a duo; id 4398 (Dusapin, Quad) has 16 players; id 4563 (Jolas, États: violin and six percussionists, 7 players) is in scope but I found neither a recording nor a programme. OWNER MAY RULE: (1) vocal works kept as chamber music: Boulez's Le Marteau sans maître, Jolivet's Suite liturgique, Jolas's Quatuor II (soprano with string trio, entered as a string quartet with a formationNote); (2) Murail's Winter Fragments counts the MIDI keyboard and computer as electronics, not as a player; (3) Murail's Portulan pieces are separate entries with the set 'Portulan', as they are published and played singly; (4) Dusapin's Trio Rombach has the violin as the main part and the clarinet as alternative (Wikipedia: 'violin or clarinet'); (5) Françaix's Nonetto (after Mozart's K. 452) and his transcriptions of Weber, Scarlatti, Schubert and Chabrier are skipped as arrangements. WEAK SPOTS (drop if in doubt): Françaix's Divertissement for string trio and piano (only a compilation album), Tailleferre's Image (MusicBrainz count and a Porter Quartet track whose scoring is not shown), Escaich's La Ronde, Scènes de bal, Après l'aurore and Scènes d'enfants au crépuscule, Amy's String Quartet No. 1, Dalbavie's Tactus (string quintet assumed to be 2 violins, viola, cello, double bass), Palimpseste and In Advance of the Broken Time, Pousseur's Madrigal II, Hersant's Apparitions. NOT CHECKED: Murail's Ethers and other ensemble works, Dalbavie's Sextuor, Pousseur's Ode and Madrigal III (recorded, instruments not confirmed); Jolas's other quartets, Mantovani's other quartets and chamber works, Hersant's other quartets (budget). The en and fr Wikipedia pages for Tailleferre and Hersant gave no readable chamber list, so those two composers were checked through MusicBrainz and the recordings only. BY HAND (orchestrating session, 2026-10-17, on the owner's instruction to leave off lesser-known works that raise flags): 12 work(s) the agent kept at low confidence were moved to skipped (reason "doubtful") and parked in data/chamber/curation/parked-low-confidence.json: Françaix: Divertissement for String Trio and Piano; Tailleferre: Image for 8 Instruments; Escaich: La Ronde; Escaich: Scènes de bal; Escaich: Après l'aurore; Escaich: Scènes d'enfants au crépuscule; Amy: String Quartet No. 1; Hersant: Apparitions; Dalbavie: Tactus; Dalbavie: Palimpseste; Dalbavie: In Advance of the Broken Time; Pousseur: Madrigal II.
